title: 感測器省略馬達估測
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討反電勢觀測器、低速可觀測性與估測融合，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore back-EMF observers, low-speed observability and estimator fusion, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。估測器適用性依電機、速度、飽和與訊號品質而異；未配置真實參考量測時不宣稱實機角度精度。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Estimator suitability depends on motor, speed, saturation and signals; do not claim real-machine angle accuracy without reference measurements.

stages.title: 模型與可觀測性
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成模型與可觀測性；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete models and observability through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 建立電壓模型：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Build voltage models: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立電壓模型，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand build voltage models through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 將 DC 電壓變動與占空比限制加入 v 模型，對比理想命令。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Add bus-voltage variation and duty limits to the voltage model and compare with ideal commands. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 將 DC 電壓變動與占空比限制加入 v 模型，對比理想命令。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Add bus-voltage variation and duty limits to the voltage model and compare with ideal commands. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「建立電壓模型」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把反電勢觀測器、低速可觀測性與估測融合的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If build voltage models disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of back-EMF observers, low-speed observability and estimator fusion behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立電壓模型」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for build voltage models, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 建立電壓模型：原理
knowledge.text: 估反電勢需要實際施加電壓，不只是控制器理想電壓命令。
knowledge.textEn: Back-EMF estimation needs applied voltage, not merely ideal voltage commands.

knowledge.title: 建立電壓模型：證據
knowledge.text: 將 DC 電壓變動與占空比限制加入 v 模型，對比理想命令。
knowledge.textEn: Add bus-voltage variation and duty limits to the voltage model and compare with ideal commands.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：用 e=v−Ri−Ldi/dt 估反電勢，若真 e=1 V、電阻誤差 ΔR=0.05 Ω、電流 10 A，僅電阻誤差就造成 0.5 V 偏差。高速 e=20 V 時同偏差只占 2.5%，顯示低速更難。 估測器適用性依電機、速度、飽和與訊號品質而異；未配置真實參考量測時不宣稱實機角度精度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: estimate e=v−Ri−Ldi/dt. If true e=1 V, resistance error ΔR=0.05 Ω at 10 A introduces 0.5 V bias. At high-speed e=20 V the same bias is only 2.5%, illustrating the low-speed difficulty. Estimator suitability depends on motor, speed, saturation and signals; do not claim real-machine angle accuracy without reference measurements.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「感測器省略馬達估測」的「建立電壓模型：建立模型」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「微電網：守住晚高峰」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Build voltage models: build the model” in “Sensorless motor estimation”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Microgrid: Protect the Evening Reserve” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

knowledge.textEn: Add approximate copper R=R₀[1+αΔT], stating α and temperature range.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：用 e=v−Ri−Ldi/dt 估反電勢，若真 e=1 V、電阻誤差 ΔR=0.05 Ω、電流 10 A，僅電阻誤差就造成 0.5 V 偏差。高速 e=20 V 時同偏差只占 2.5%，顯示低速更難。 估測器適用性依電機、速度、飽和與訊號品質而異；未配置真實參考量測時不宣稱實機角度精度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: estimate e=v−Ri−Ldi/dt. If true e=1 V, resistance error ΔR=0.05 Ω at 10 A introduces 0.5 V bias. At high-speed e=20 V the same bias is only 2.5%, illustrating the low-speed difficulty. Estimator suitability depends on motor, speed, saturation and signals; do not claim real-machine angle accuracy without reference measurements.
